description.value:
You become a living archive of possible selves.

Once per a Soma Break, as a bonus action, you manifest the Thousandfold Echo for 1 minute:

  • You may switch between your prepared personas as a free interaction (no action) on your turn.
  • Whenever you switch personas, you gain a +1 bonus to your next Stealth (Intrigue), Diplomacy (Presence), or Performance (Presence) check before the end of your turn (stacking up to a maximum of +3).
  • During this time, creatures attempting to recall your true identity or appearance have disadvantage on such checks or saves.

Strategic Echo. If a major intrigue, Parley, or Courtly Intrigue scenario concluded under Thousandfold Echo ends in a Best Friends / Integration or Justice / Reformation style outcome, your faction gains +1 Soft Power OP and +1 Intrigue OP as the legend of your many faces spreads.

system.requirements: Dreamwalker 18, Trance of the Thousand Faces
